DEWARIM_FILES.Title: File Commander
DEWARIM_FILES.PreviewHint: Click a file to preview it. Drag files to the other pane to copy, onto the canvas for a tile, or drop files from the desktop into a pane to upload them there.
DEWARIM_FILES.Keys: F4 copy · F6 copy as · F7 new folder · Tab other pane · Backspace up · Ctrl/Shift-click to select several
DEWARIM_FILES.LedgerCount: {count} copies recorded - their sources can be deleted once nothing uses them.
DEWARIM_FILES.ReadOnly: Foundry's own files are read-only - copy into user data instead.
DEWARIM_FILES.NoUpload: You may not upload files (permission "Upload New Files").
DEWARIM_FILES.CopyAsHint: New name; the extension (.{ext}) is kept if you leave it out. The original stays.
DEWARIM_FILES.CopyAsManyHint: {n} numbers the files (cave-{n} → cave-1, cave-2 …); without it, -1, -2 … are appended. Extensions are kept.
